name: Camp Manager Fergus

intro.text: I run six thousand acres, ten thousand sheep and a Land Rover I wouldn't give a dog. It's a lot of work, and I'll take a break from it for a battle.

win: Right. The best fight I've had at smoko. Come in and have a scone.
after: A Camp farm can cover tens of thousands of acres, with sheep outnumbering everything and a neighbour a long way off. People look out for each other, because they have to.
